profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company that describes itself as pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility worldwide. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, it says it has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios and has built its systems around a core technology it calls a "virtual driver." The company organizes its work into three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). It states that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations.

The company is publicly traded under the ticker PONY and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001969302. Its headquarters are listed as Guangzhou. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers appear in the records held for it.
